crossRefs.note: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and…
He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
Moses built an altar, and called its name “Yahweh our Banner”.
Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
translations.bsb: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where God had spoken with him—a stone marker—and he poured out a drink offering on it and anointed it with oil.
translations.kjv: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil
translations.asv: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spake with him, a pillar of stone: and he poured out a drink-offering thereon, and poured oil thereon.
